mapper.select: SELECT s.schedule_id, s.application_id, s.scheduled_at, s.location, s.round, s.status, a.applicant_name, j.title AS posting_title, u.name AS interviewer_name, s.interviewer_id FROM interview_schedule s JOIN application a ON s.application_id = a.application_id JOIN job_posting j ON a.posting_id = j.posting_id JOIN users u ON s.interviewer_id = u.user_id ORDER BY s.scheduled_at DESC

SELECT s.schedule_id, s.application_id, s.scheduled_at, s.location, s.round, s.status, a.applicant_name, j.title AS posting_title, u.name AS interviewer_name FROM interview_schedule s JOIN application a ON s.application_id = a.application_id JOIN job_posting j ON a.posting_id = j.posting_id JOIN users u ON s.interviewer_id = u.user_id WHERE s.interviewer_id = #{interviewerId} ORDER BY s.scheduled_at ASC

SELECT s.*, a.applicant_name, j.title AS posting_title, u.name AS interviewer_name FROM interview_schedule s JOIN application a ON s.application_id = a.application_id JOIN job_posting j ON a.posting_id = j.posting_id JOIN users u ON s.interviewer_id = u.user_id WHERE s.schedule_id = #{scheduleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_schedule (application_id, interviewer_id, scheduled_at, location, round, status, created_at) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{interviewerId}, #{scheduledAt}, #{location}, #{round}, 'SCHEDULED', NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE interview_schedule SET status = 'DONE' WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId}
UPDATE interview_schedule SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, name, email FROM users WHERE role = 'INTERVIEWER' AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY name ASC

SELECT a.application_id, a.applicant_name, a.email, j.title AS posting_title FROM application a JOIN job_posting j ON a.posting_id = j.posting_id WHERE a.stage NOT IN ('PASSED','REJECTED') ORDER BY a.applied_at DESC
